description: Set a program's milestones/waves and the initiatives assigned to each — the whole ordered list in one call. This REPLACES the stored list: to add, rename, re-date or delete a single milestone, read the program first (anyforge_get_program), change the array, and pass the union back; an id you omit is deleted. An initiative may sit in at most one milestone — assigning it to one removes it from any other. Moving a milestone's targetDate records the move in its history when you supply targetDateReason. Requires `write` scope and a key holder who can edit programs.

milestones.description: The complete ordered milestone/wave list. Each entry: { id?, name, description?, targetDate? (ISO yyyy-mm-dd), initiativeIds? (initiatives assigned to this wave), internalOnly?, targetDateReason? }. Omit id to create; omit an existing id to delete it.

id.description: Existing milestone id; omit to create a new one.

initiativeIds.description: Initiatives assigned to this wave (exclusive — removed from any other milestone).

internalOnly.description: Hide this milestone from external readers.

targetDate.description: Target date (ISO yyyy-mm-dd); empty string clears it.

targetDateReason.description: Why the date moved; recorded in the milestone's date history.

name: anyforge_set_program_milestones
title: Set program milestones
